content.title: Japanese-Inspired Character Roster | Role Symbols and Ensemble Archive
content.summary: Six adult mountain-clan specialists enter one fixed indigo dossier and reunite in a role map. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed mechanical aperture, portrait bay, dial and field order remain registered. + Every clearly adult original role changes four comparison fields together: face, silhouette, stance and tool. + The aperture fully closes between identities and cannot hide a partial morph. + One reveal interval contains exactly one adult identity and readable role evidence. + The terminal radial roster restores every established adult, number and tool around the same central mechanism.
quick_start.recommended_input: Create one fixed indigo-paper dossier with a portrait slot, role icon, two-field caption and numbered seal for six clearly adult original mountain-clan characters. Use the identical field order for an adult bridge guard, herb judge, bell runner, archive diver and storm negotiator, changing face, silhouette, pose and one duty object each time. Assemble all six adults around the original title "RIDGE COVENANT" with every number and duty icon still readable in the terminal roster.
required_anchors: One fixed roster frame, field order and numbered progression remain registered throughout.
Every clearly adult original character changes face, silhouette, pose and one role object together.
Recurring palette and ornament preserve the taxonomy while role evidence changes.
The terminal ensemble includes every established adult with readable number and duty symbol.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Six adult mountain-clan specialists enter one fixed indigo dossier and reunite in a role map. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定一套和风图鉴框架和字段顺序，让多个成年原创角色逐一以面孔、姿态、职责物与主题符号完成登记；每人只占一个清楚槽位，终局把全体角色聚合为可比较群像。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One fixed roster frame, field order and numbered progression remain registered throughout.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One fixed roster frame, field order and numbered progression remain registered throughout."

invariants.rule: Every clearly adult original character changes face, silhouette, pose and one role object together.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every clearly adult original character changes face, silhouette, pose and one role object together."

invariants.rule: One card contains one identity; transitions cannot morph two characters into an ambiguous hybrid.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One card contains one identity; transitions cannot morph two characters into an ambiguous hybrid."

invariants.rule: Recurring palette and ornament preserve the taxonomy while role evidence changes.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Recurring palette and ornament preserve the taxonomy while role evidence changes."

invariants.rule: The terminal ensemble includes every established adult with readable number and duty symbol.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal ensemble includes every established adult with readable number and duty symbol."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
